text:
lisa_fin: Hey team, noticed a batch of Azure Marketplace invoice lines where the partner_id field has an extra 'ch-' prefix. That causes our reseller lookup to fail and seats to be billed to the wrong account.

sam.billing: Oof. How many lines affected? Any customer impact yet?

lisa_fin: Roughly 74 lines across 22 invoices in the 2026-04-02 export. Example: ```invoice_id,sku,partner_id,units,amount
az-2026-04-02-101,app-seat,ch-789012,10,500.00
az-2026-04-02-102,app-seat,789012,5,250.00``` In our DB the lookup expects numeric-only partner_id.

chetana_partner_ops: We recently onboarded a channel partner that uses 'ch-' prefixes in their internal reports; maybe Azure mirrored that field downstream. I'll ask them if they pushed a new format.

ingestbot: Ingest pipeline log: "partner lookup failed: key mismatch: 'ch-789012' not found" at 2026-04-02T08:14:22Z. The pipeline is currently dropping unmatched lines to prevent accidental billing.

mike_sre: Dropping is correct safety-wise but we need an operational path. Suggest we add a tolerant lookup layer that strips known prefixes for the next 48h while we confirm source format. I'll open a hotfix.

lisa_fin: Agreed. We should also notify affected customers and create credit hold records if charges were already applied. Tara, can sales reach out to partners impacted?

tara_sales: On it. I'll ping the partner PMs and ask for confirmation of the new identifier format. Also will prep customer comms templates.

sam.billing: Technical mitigation plan: 1) temporary lookup shim to canonicalize partner_id by removing /^ch-/; 2) mark any canonicalized match with a ticket for reconciliation and a revenue_hold flag; 3) run reprocess for the day's export. 4) if partner confirms prefix is intentional, add to mapping rules.

mike_sre: Branch created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/compare/patch/strip-azure-prefix . Includes unit tests for canonicalization and a deploy doc. Rolling to staging now.

invoicebot: Automation: queued reprocess job id rc-20260402-az-prefix-1 by sam.billing.

chetana_partner_ops: Partner responded: they deployed an ID normalization in their reporting system yesterday as part of a portal update. They're willing to keep the old format for exports for 72 hours while we patch, and they will publish the change doc.

lisa_fin: Good. Put a temporary GAAP-safe hold on any disputed charges until reconciliation finishes. Sam, please coordinate with finance ops to generate credit memos if needed.

sam.billing: Will do. Running a reconciliation sweep now. Preliminary: 68 of 74 lines remapped by the shim; 6 require manual confirm (partner-specific custom tags).

mike_sre: Deployed shim to production with canary 10% traffic then 100% at 2026-04-02T11:05Z. No errors in logs.

lisa_fin: Thanks all. Follow-up: once partner publishes formal change notice, we'll update our partner onboarding docs and mapping table. Closing once manual confirms complete or credits issued.
